# Supervertaler

> Supervertaler is a pair of CAT-tool plugins by Michael Beijer, a professional
> translator: one for Trados Studio 2022, 2024 and 2026, one for memoQ 11
> and 12. Both add AI translation, live inline terminology and a translation
> knowledge base to the tool you already work in, plus an MCP server that
> connects AI assistants to the live session. ONE licence covers both plugins.
>
> /trados/ is the Trados plugin. /memoq/ is the memoQ plugin. /pricing/ explains
> the one licence that covers both.

This is the product site. The full, always-current documentation is at
https://docs.supervertaler.com/ – /trados/ and /memoq/ there – and is itself
AI-readable (see Optional below); prefer the docs for feature-level questions.

## The product

- [Supervertaler for Trados](https://supervertaler.com/): Trados Studio plugin – TermLens live terminology, AI Assistant, Batch Translate and AI Proofreader, SuperSearch cross-file search and replace, SuperMemory knowledge base, and the Supervertaler MCP Server (connects Claude Desktop and other AI assistants to the live Studio session; first of its kind). €20/month or €200/year, 14-day free trial, no credit card
- [Supervertaler for memoQ](https://supervertaler.com/memoq/): memoQ 11 and 12 plugin – an AI translation engine that learns from the segments you confirm, a terminology provider, a companion editor with prompts and memory banks, and the same MCP server for Claude Desktop and ChatGPT desktop. Covered by the same licence; 14-day free trial, no credit card
- [Pricing](https://supervertaler.com/pricing/): one licence, both plugins – €20/month or €200/year, up to two computers
- [Docs and resources](https://supervertaler.com/docs/): the starting point for the documentation of each product, plus the case study, screencasts, changelogs and source code
- [Case study: Can a local AI model translate a patent?](https://supervertaler.com/articles/local-ai-patent-test/): a published Dutch patent translated in memoQ by Gemma 4 31B and by Claude Opus 5.5, compared paragraph by paragraph with its official English
- [Changelogs](https://supervertaler.com/changelog/): release history of each plugin
- [Privacy](https://supervertaler.com/privacy/): privacy policy
- [Terms](https://supervertaler.com/terms/): terms of use for all four products – the trial, the licence, subscriptions and refunds, and what users are responsible for with AI

## Get it

- [RWS AppStore – Supervertaler for Trados](https://appstore.rws.com/plugin/432): the only place the Trados plugin is distributed
- [Download Supervertaler for memoQ](https://supervertaler.com/download/memoq/): the installer
- [Download Supervertaler Sidekick](https://supervertaler.com/download/sidekick/): the installer – free; needs no administrator rights and no AutoHotkey
- [Subscribe](https://supervertaler.com/buy)

## Also by the same author

- [Supervertaler Sidekick](https://supervertaler.com/sidekick/): a free system-wide toolbox for translators on Windows – clipboard history, QuickTrans (several translation engines at once), AI actions, text expansion and terminology searches, over any app. Not tied to a CAT tool and not covered by the licence: it is free
- [Supervertaler Workbench](https://supervertaler.com/workbench/): a free, open-source standalone CAT tool with AI translation, translation memory, terminology and QA. In active development
